result.title: HyInv Technical Report
result.summary: Inverse folding designs amino-acid sequences for a given protein backbone, and screening needs many candidates that are both diverse and well folded. We present HyInv, a 1.96-million-parameter backbone-conditioned graph network with an encoder-decoder architecture, trained by Hyra 2.0, the research agent developed by our team: pretrained with random-order autoregressive sequence modeling, followed by structure-reward reinforcement learning. At inference, a grouped draft-and-rewrite sampler that uses separate draft and rewrite temperatures improves refolding TM-score at matched diversity. An optimized implementation with BF16 numerics designs 128 sequences for a 402-residue backbone in 50.6 ms on a single NVIDIA H20 GPU, about 52 times faster than the reference sampler, and an exact FP32 path that returns the reference sequences is 8.7 times faster. Across five benchmark datasets and seven dataset-predictor combinations, HyInv reaches a higher average scTM than all ten external baselines at comparable or higher sequence diversity, with large margins over ProteinMPNN and ProteinZero V2. The same default setting supports de novo backbones, pocket-constrained libraries, enzyme redesign with the catalytic site kept, and loop redesign. We have released our code and model at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hyra-results/tree/main/AI4Science/hyinv.

AI.brief_summary: HyInv 是一个 196 万参数的骨架条件图网络，用于蛋白质逆折叠序列设计，采用随机顺序自回归预训练加结构奖励强化学习，并以分组 draft-and-rewrite 采样提升回折质量与速度。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是蛋白质序列设计任务，不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态、证据获取与停止决策，draft-and-rewrite 采样虽属迭代改写，但与 LVR 的 latent 状态生成和训练监督缺少具体可迁移线索，故排除。
